jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Backend Platform (USA Only, 100% Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so  Close  does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. 
 We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. 
 Our Stack 
 Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our  TaskTiger  scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented  public API  that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools.  
 We love open sourcing our code and ideas on  our GitHub  and on  The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like  SocketShark ,  TaskTiger ,  LimitLion  and  ciso8601 . 
 AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.  
 About the Role 
 Close runs on Python: Flask web apps, TaskTiger, billions of MongoDB documents, a public REST API that customers and external agents both build on. Four product teams ship features on top of that every week. Backend Platforms owns the foundation underneath it all. 
 As an Engineer on our Backend Platforms team, you’re building for other engineers. When a product team adds a new API endpoint, most of what they write isn't their feature — it's wiring: authentication, permissions, rate limiting, the shape the endpoint has to take so it looks like every other endpoint when you squint. Multiply that across telemetry, eventing, database migrations, authorization, and local development, and you get the problem this team exists to solve: make the paved road faster to walk than the trail. 
 The other half of the team's mandate is the AI development platform. We've built DevDawg, cloud-based development environments preconfigured for our entire application stack and our engineering practices, and Spice, our extension layer on top of a coding agent that runs internal review workflows and root cause analysis. Spice is hooked into GitHub and can already approve mergeable pull requests on its own for simple changes. This team is responsible for expanding what it can safely handle. 
 This is a new team. You would be one of the first hires, and you'd have unusual influence over what the team owns and how it operates. 
 One thing to know: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close — this team is where you'd start, but over time you'll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects. 
 This role is open at the Senior and Staff levels. You don't need to pick one when you apply: we'll calibrate together during the process. 

 You are 
 
 
  A seasoned Python engineer.  Python is our backbone and it matters in this role more than on other teams at Close. Architectural patterns don't port cleanly between languages, and you'll be setting the patterns. Go, Rust, or TypeScript alongside it is welcome. 
 
 
  Drawn to met

jobs.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product  Playtime Arcade , we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.   Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive   The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With  over 200 million monthly visits , there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.  The system runs on  AWS Spot Instances  spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by  Kubernetes  with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at  200 million monthly visits . The frontend is built on  React  and  Vite , leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run  A/B experiments  per  more than 2000 games  on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.    Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For     Production Golang Systems Expertise:  You bring 5+ years of backend development experience, including at least 3 years writing Go in production distributed environments. You will build and maintain our +99% Go microservice architecture—interfacing with our TypeScript/React frontend—to reliably handle 2+ million daily publisher interactions and scale beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.     High-Throughput Event Streaming:  You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.     High-Scale Data & API Optimization:  You understand database internals and low-level web standards (HTTP protocol, Encoding, Regular Expressions). You will optimize queries across hundreds of terabytes of data across DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena to reduce API response times and expose transparent, well-documented open APIs to enterprise partners.     Data Science & Algorithmic Integration:  You quickly grasp complex technical topics and applied mathematics. You will partner directly with our Data Science team to translate and integrate machine learning algorithms into adjoe’s core application, optimizing real-time ad targeting.     Collaborative Technical Communication:  You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You will actively participate in peer code reviews and technical knowledge sharing across an international backend engineering team.     Plus: Infrastructure & Cloud Tooling:  Hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code), Docker containerization, or serverless infrastructure.     🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.      At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.     Go Big.  Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.
